scripts.build:perry: node scripts/prepare.ts && perry compile tui/src/main.ts -o dist/chess --strict-eval --strict-dynamic-import --strict-unimplemented
scripts.build:perry:small: node scripts/prepare-perry-small.ts && PERRY_LL_OPT_LEVEL=z perry compile dist/perry-small/source/tui/src/main.ts -o dist/chess-small --function-source header --strict-eval --strict-dynamic-import --strict-unimplemented && strip dist/chess-small && codesign --force --sign - dist/chess-small
scripts.test:perry:small: node scripts/prepare-perry-small.ts && PERRY_LL_OPT_LEVEL=z perry compile dist/perry-small/source/tests/run.ts -o dist/chess-small-tests --function-source header --strict-eval --strict-dynamic-import --strict-unimplemented && CHESS_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS=${CHESS_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS:-300000} CHESS_NATIVE=./dist/chess-small CHESS_NATIVE_TESTS=./dist/chess-small-tests node tests/integration.ts && node tests/text-parity.ts ./dist/chess-small && python3 tests/terminal.py ./dist/chess-small
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && npm run build:perry && node scripts/benchmark.ts
scripts.build:scriptc:trial: node scripts/prepare-scriptc.ts && dist/toolchains/scriptc-0.4.7/bin/scriptc build dist/compiler-trials/scriptc-adapted/tui/src/main.ts --tier static-only --node-islands off -o dist/compiler-trials/chess-scriptc-adapted
scripts.test:scriptc:trial: node scripts/prepare.ts && dist/toolchains/scriptc-0.4.7/bin/scriptc build tests/run.ts --tier static-only --node-islands off -o dist/chess-tests-scriptc && dist/chess-tests-scriptc
scripts.test:porffor:trial: node scripts/prepare.ts && bun build tests/run.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/chess-tests-porffor.js && dist/toolchains/porffor-alpha-19/porf native --module dist/chess-tests-porffor.js -o dist/chess-tests-porffor && dist/chess-tests-porffor
scripts.test:perry: node scripts/prepare.ts && perry compile tests/run.ts -o dist/chess-tests --strict-eval --strict-dynamic-import --strict-unimplemented && dist/chess-tests
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test && npm run test:bun && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:server && npm run build && npm run test:perry && npm run build:perry && npm run test:integration
scripts.build:server:perry: node scripts/prepare.ts && perry compile server/src/main.ts -o dist/chess-server --strict-eval --strict-dynamic-import --strict-unimplemented
scripts.test:server:perry: npm run build:server:perry && CHESS_SERVER=./dist/chess-server node tests/server.ts
scripts.build:engine:perry: node scripts/prepare.ts && perry compile cli/src/main.ts -o dist/chess-engine --strict-eval --strict-dynamic-import --strict-unimplemented
scripts.plugin:validate: claude plugin validate . && claude plugin validate plugin
